final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT s.transref, t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.instownpct) AS avg_instown FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = s.transref GROUP BY s.transref, t.ordertypedist), step2 AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(avg_instown) AS avg_of_group FROM step1 GROUP BY ordertypedist), step3 AS (SELECT step1.transref, step1.ordertypedist, step1.avg_instown, step1.avg_instown / NULLIF(step2.avg_of_group, 0) AS ratio FROM step1 JOIN step2 ON step1.ordertypedist = step2.ordertypedist), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_instown) AS overall_avg FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT step3.transref, step3.ordertypedist, step3.avg_instown, step3.ratio, step3.avg_instown - step4.overall_avg AS diff FROM step3 JOIN step4 ON step4.overall_avg IS NOT NULL WHERE step3.avg_instown > step4.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_instown), AVG(ratio), AVG(diff) FROM step5
